title: Watcher finding body
description: A collusion finding of the society watcher (register row DK391, S601), put in the log so the Clinic can cite it (register row DK520; spec-delta S961). Signed by the watcher's own key, which the log knows from the watcher's passport (the watcher is a software process of the service, not a person: its key is registered so a finding in the log can be checked by anyone). A lead and nothing more: it settles no job, slashes no bond and changes no standing; its use is a Clinic checkup order that cites it (clinic_order reason collusion_finding). Chain: none (prev is null).

finding_id.description: The watcher's own id of the finding (the hash of the finding it signed in its public feed), so the record and the feed are tied together.
